They carry a human ORCID as creator/signer. The 139 drafts deliberately do not (team decision of 2026-10-31, claim-tests/nanopubs/DECISIONS.md): the creator is the software agent until the key owner approves.

They are source-attestation records: one claim extracted from On the Origin of Species with its chapter and quoted sentence, plus a dataset-resolvability assessment. They carry no test result, no measured number, no pre-registration and no delphi:EvidenceItem of the kind the 2026-10-31 standing order requires.
They predate the Delphi v2.0 term set used by the drafts and the one-record-per-finding standing order, so they are not directly comparable and are counted separately everywhere in this index.
They are irreversible: corrections need a supersede, withdrawals a retract, both signed by the same identity. Nothing in this index touches them.
